items.title: Electric Field as Potential Gradient (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Electric Field as Potential Gradient: a main subheading of 9.5 Electric potential, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 202-204.

blocks.text: Ab electric intensity aur potential difference ka relation (taalluq) nikalte hain. Fig. 9.16 dobara dekhein: plates ke darmiyan field uniform hai aur us ki qeemat E hai. A aur B ka potential difference:
Yahan W_AB = Fd = −qEd. Minus sign is liye ke charge ko equilibrium mein rakhne ke liye F ko qE ke ulat lagana parta hai. Is tarah Eq. 9.21:

blocks.alt: Do graphs: potential difference (oopar wala teer) time (sideways teer) ke saath. Oopar 'EEG (Normal alpha rhythm)': blue patti par tez, be-qaida lehrati (wavy) trace. Neeche 'EEG (Abnormal)': halki line wali patti par taqreeban seedhi trace jis mein teen tez spikes hain, har ek mein chhota ubhaar aur gehri dip.
blocks.caption: Brain ki EEG traces: normal alpha rhythm aur abnormal (kitab ki bina caption wali tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer par dono traces ke saath 'ECG' likha hai. Alpha rhythm dimagh (brain) ki lehar (wave) hai aur box electroencephalography ke baare mein hai, is liye yeh EEG traces hain; upar ki drawing par EEG likha hai.

Electroencephalography (EEG) mein brain (dimagh) ki electrical activity (sargarmi) se bane potential differences record kiye jate hain; in se abnormal behaviour (ghair-mamooli baratao) ki diagnosis (bimari ki pehchan) hoti hai.
Agar plates A aur B ka faasla bohat hi chhota Δd ho to Eq. 9.22 yun ban jati hai:

ΔV/Δd batata hai ke faasle ke saath potential kitni tezi se badalta hai; field line ke saath chalne par plates ka faasla Δd sab se kam hota hai, is liye yeh sab se zyada (maximum) rate hai. Ise potential gradient kehte hain. Yani electric intensity potential gradient ka negative (manfi) hai. Minus sign batata hai ke E ki direction (rukh) ghatte hue potential ki taraf hai (+ plate se − plate ki taraf).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar wali trace normal brain ki alpha rhythm hai: lagataar tez, chhoti lehrein (waves). Neeche abnormal trace hai: zyada tar seedhi line aur beech beech mein achanak tez spikes. Doctor (tabeeb) inhi farqon se dimagh ki bimari pehchante hain. Dimagh ki recording EEG kehlati hai, is liye drawing par EEG likha hai (kitab ne ghalti se 'ECG' likha tha).
Eq. 9.23 se electric intensity ki unit volt/metre (V m⁻¹) hai, jo N C⁻¹ ke barabar hai:

blocks.text_alt: 1 volt/metre = 1 (joule/coulomb)/metre = 1 (newton × metre)/(metre × coulomb) = 1 newton/coulomb = 1 N C⁻¹

blocks.title: Example 9.4
blocks.problem: Do parallel metal (dhaat) ki plates 1.0 cm door hain aur 12 volt ki battery se jori hain. Un ke darmiyan electric field intensity nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: ΔV = 12 V, Δd = 1.0 cm = 1 × 10⁻² m, E = ?

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki aakhri line mein 12 V ko "1×10 m" se divide kiya gaya hai; power −2 reh gayi hai. Sahi 1 × 10⁻² m hai (pehli line mein bhi yehi hai), aur jawab 1200 V m⁻¹ theek hai.

blocks.title: Example 9.5
blocks.problem: Do horizontal parallel metal ki plates 12 volt ki battery se jori hain. Negative plate se ek electron chhora jata hai. Positive plate tak pohanchte waqt us ki velocity nikalein. Electron ka mass = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg, charge q = e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C.
steps: Electron negative plate se door dhakela jata hai aur positive plate ki taraf kheencha jata hai, is liye woh positive plate ki taraf tez hota (accelerate) jata hai. Jo P.E. woh khota hai woh K.E. ban jati hai.
P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka faida: ΔV × e = ½ mv²
Qeematein: 12 V × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C = ½ × 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg × v²

blocks.prompt: Electric potential define karein aur sabit karein ke electric field intensity potential gradient ka negative hai (comprehensive question 9.1). 50 μC charge se 50 cm door potential nikalein (MCQ 9.5). Electric appliances chalate waqt rubber ke talwon wale joote kyun pehnne chahiyein (Point to ponder)?
blocks.explanation: Kisi point par potential = positive charge ko infinity se wahan lane mein har unit charge par kaam, V = W/q. Plates ke darmiyan W_AB = −qEd, is liye V_B − V_A = −Ed aur E = −ΔV/Δd, yani potential gradient ka negative. V = kq/r = (9 × 10⁹ × 50 × 10⁻⁶)/0.5 = 9 × 10⁵ V: option (c). Rubber insulator hai: yeh body (jism) se zameen tak current ka raasta poora nahi hone deta, is liye agar live taar chhu bhi jaye to body se bohat kam ya koi current nahi guzarta.

items: Charge q ko E ke khilaf A se B uniform velocity se le jana: ΔU = W_AB (9.16).
Potential difference ΔV = W_AB/q = ΔU/q (9.17); ΔU = qΔV (9.18); 1 V = 1 J C⁻¹ (9.19); potential V = W/q, infinity se (9.20); dono scalar.
E = −ΔV/Δd (9.23): field potential gradient ka negative, ghatte potential ki taraf; V m⁻¹ = N C⁻¹.
Examples: 1200 V m⁻¹; electron 2.1 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹.
